description: FK to Calendar Date Dimension — ngày snapshot = ngày thực tế nộp báo cáo (BA: ngay_nop)
etl_logic: LOOKUP cdr_dt_dim ON cdr_dt_dim.cdr_dt = MAX(fir_value.submission_dt) FROM fir_value INNER JOIN fir_structure ON fir_structure.fir_structure_id = fir_value.fir_structure_id INNER JOIN foreign_investor_report ON foreign_investor_report.fir_id = fir_structure.fir_id WHERE foreign_investor_report.rpt_code = 'IBOU9' AND foreign_investor_report.sheet_nm = 'I' AND fir_value.total_row_ind = 0 AND fir_value.section_echo_ind = 0 AND fir_value.band_overflow_ind = 0 AND fir_value.static_copy_ind = 0 AND fir_value.rpt_marker_ind = 0 [pivot 1 dòng báo cáo: GROUP BY fir_value.rpt_log_id, fir_structure.section_id, fir_value.dynamic_row_order]
